heading: PROFILE.
paragraphs: I am an Information Engineering graduate with a strong interest in data-driven technologies and digital solutions. My background spans data engineering, analytics, database systems, and applied artificial intelligence. I enjoy exploring how technology and data can be leveraged to solve complex problems and create meaningful impact.

Professionally, I have gained experience working as a contract and freelance Data Engineer, contributing to data processing, pipeline development, and database-related projects. Alongside my professional work, I have also served as a Teaching Assistant at Universitas Gadjah Mada, supporting undergraduate courses in Data Mining and Artificial Intelligence. These experiences have strengthened both my technical capabilities and my ability to communicate and share knowledge.
